Subject: HedgeRisk compliance walkthrough — scope & timing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing for our SOC 2 + DPA review with an external pen test scheduled the week after next. Before we lock in the formal intake, can Redwood run a short walkthrough so our security team and the pen vendor have a clear view of the controls and what you'll need from us?

High-level asks:
- 60–90 minute walkthrough covering network architecture, data flows affecting scope, and your SOC 2 control families.
- A prior 20-minute "dry run" with Redwood ops to validate evidence handoff (SFTP/Drive push) and bridge details.
- List of specific evidence artifacts you expect for the controls mapping.

Our availability window: Jun 16–20 (prioritise mornings ET). If you can share preferred slots and an attendee list from Redwood, we'll confirm on our side.

Attendees from HedgeRisk: James Pritchard (Security lead), Alex Turner (IT ops), plus a rep from SecureLabs (pen vendor) once time is confirmed.

Thanks,
James

--

2) Main walkthrough (90 mins): controls mapping + Q&A + next steps
   - Options: Jun 18 13:30–15:00 ET or Jun 19 09:00–10:30 ET

From Redwood: I'll lead the controls discussion and bring Ben Carter (SOC 2 / controls) and Marissa Cole (infrastructure & ops). Can you confirm whether SecureLabs needs to join the main walkthrough or just the readout after the pen plan? Also please confirm timezone and whether you prefer Google Calendar invites (we'll attach the controls mapping worksheet).

I've attached a short controls mapping template and our pen-test playbook stub to make the preflight efficient. If you have any high-priority control IDs to highlight, send them over and we'll call them out in the agenda.

Attachments: soc2-controls-mapping.xlsx (stub), redwood-pen-test-playbook.pdf (summary)

If any of these slots work, I'll send calendar invites with bridge details.

Best,

- SecureLabs will join the main walkthrough (they want to hear the control scope directly).

- Confirmed attendees from our side: myself, Alex Turner (IT ops), Maria Gutierrez from SecureLabs (m.gutierrez@securelabs.io).
- Evidence transfer: we typically push large artifacts to an SFTP endpoint. If you can send SFTP credentials and a preferred directory layout during the dry run, that'll speed evidence ingestion.

Let's do:
- Dry run: Jun 18 15:00–15:20 UTC (which is 11:00–11:20 ET)
- Walkthrough: Jun 18 17:30–19:00 UTC (13:30–15:00 ET)

Please send calendar invites and the bridge details.
